hero.tagline: I design experiences that make complex things feel simple.

about.teaser: I'm a UX/UI and product designer who believes great design lives at the intersection of clarity, empathy, and craft.
about.title: About
about.bio1: I design digital products that solve real problems — with a process rooted in research, iteration, and attention to detail.
about.bio2: From B2B SaaS platforms to consumer mobile apps, I've worked across industries to turn complex challenges into experiences that feel effortless.
about.p1body: Every design decision should reduce friction, not add to it. I simplify — even when the problem isn't simple.
about.p2body: Good product design means thinking in systems: how components relate, how states behave, how everything scales.
about.p3body: Research isn't a checkbox. Understanding the real person using the product is the only way to design something that actually works.
